# crumbkit's schemas

These files are copies of `crates/crumbkit/schemas/commands-list-v1.json`,
`schemas-list-v1.json`, `schemas-show-v1.json` and `failure-v1.json` from
crumbkit at commit `b7f02c45fe90ac461e90f59a2c559ce11bba479c`, the merge
of crumbkit/crumbkit#291 after the 0.1.1 release and the commit that
`scripts/install-test-tools.sh` installs shelf and reading from. They move
with that commit.
